content:
Last week Sonos unveiled several new features coming to its app, and the first wave of upgrades has now arrived via the "Sonos 27" app update. Here's everything you need to know.

Below are the new and upcoming features in Sonos 27 software, as announced by Sonos.

Sonos has followed the lead of iOS 27 and others by adopting a similar naming convention for its software platform: "Sonos 27."

Sonos 27 is available starting today through a new app update on the App Store. Wondering if your hardware is compatible? Sonos says it's for "all Sonos S2 products," though feature availability will vary by device.

Here's what Sonos says is available right now:

  • Portable Surround Sound: "Two identical Sonos portable speakers (Move 2 or Sonos Play) can pair with a compatible soundbar to act as rear surround speakers. When the speakers are moved away, they automatically revert to their original role—giving existing hardware more use cases without needing to dedicate a home theater setup."
  • New Sonos 27 App Navigation: "A redesigned app with cleaner navigation, swipe gestures, and the ability to pin rooms for faster control."
  • Headphone Connection (Early Access): "Ace Ultra headphones can connect to your Sonos system, letting users push and switch audio between nearby speakers and the headphones directly, without using a phone as a middleman."
  • Sonos 27 MCP (Early Access): "Connects AI helpers like ChatGPT and Claude to Sonos, giving users more choice instead of locking them into a single assistant."

Sonos also teased two more features on the way:

  • Sonos 27 Voice (Later This Fall): "Sonos's own music-first assistant, built on the idea that your home shouldn't be dominated by a single AI, with consumer choice at its core."
  • Sonos Custom Agents (2027): "Lets users build their own agents within the system, each with its own model, personality, and voice."

Sonos's last major app redesign, rolled out a few years ago, caused quite a stir. This navigation refresh is clearly more modest in scope—hopefully it won't spark the same kind of controversy.

What do you think of the changes in the Sonos 27 app? Let us know in the comments.
